permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.intro: Control the capabilities available to each role and grant individual exceptions to specific users. Capabilities are enforced on both the server and the interface — changes here take effect on the next request.
permissions.adminHint: Administrators always hold every capability. This role cannot be edited.
permissions.roleHint: Choose the capabilities this role grants. Users with individual overrides keep them.
permissions.userSelectEmptyDesc: Pick a user from the list above to view or edit their capability overrides.
permissions.overrideHint: Individual overrides layer on top of the {role} role.

capability.tests.download_full_bank: tests.download_full_bank — allows downloading the full accessible question bank. Requires study access; denying it stops new bulk downloads and resume without deleting existing packs.
capability.system.bypass_expiry: Exempts the account from expiry. Administrators always hold this capability.

users.activationUnknown: The activation request for user #{id} may have succeeded. Read the current status before another action.
users.title: User management
users.confirmDelete: Are you sure you want to permanently delete user {username}? This cannot be undone.
users.confirmDeletePassword: Enter your password to confirm deletion
users.formAdminPasswordRequired: Admin password is required to confirm
users.resetNewPasswordPlaceholder: Leave blank to generate a random password
users.resetTempPasswordHint: A temporary password was generated. Copy it now — it will not be shown again. The user will be required to change it at first sign-in.

settings.connectionHint: Export an unencrypted JSON file so users can select their server without typing its address. Nested decorative metadata is not encryption. No accounts or credentials are included.
settings.connectionAddressHint: Enter the HTTP/HTTPS origin or full API URL ending in /api/v1/, including any deployment prefix. Use an address recipients can reach. Exporting does not change server settings.
settings.connectionInvalid: Enter a valid http:// or https:// origin or /api/v1/ URL without credentials, query parameters or a fragment.
settings.connectionDownloadStarted: Download requested. Share the file with users; they can import it at first launch or through Change server.
settings.connectionExportFailed: Could not start the connection file download. The address has been kept.
settings.title: System settings
settings.opsIntro: Run these tasks separately from saving settings. Recalculation updates reputation; sample data adds demonstration questions to the shared bank.
settings.examDurationHint: The default duration for an exam session
settings.rankRefreshDesc: Updates each user's trust score and question count from their current data, which recomputes author ranks (authority, expert, contributor, etc.).
settings.rankRefreshLast: Last result: {updated} updated out of {scanned} users.
settings.rankRefreshNone: No changes — all values are up to date ({scanned} users scanned)
settings.seedDesc: Adds the demo question set to the bank — ten standalone questions and two linked clinical cases (major depression, first psychotic episode) for demonstration and testing. Existing questions are not added again.
settings.subtitle: Shared account and exam defaults. Edit the values, then save to apply them system-wide.
settings.generalHint: Starting expiry and auto-renewal values for new accounts in user management. Saving these defaults does not change existing accounts.
settings.examsHint: The time limit for new exam sessions. Running sessions keep their current deadline.
settings.integerRequired: Enter a whole number of {min} or more.
settings.seedConfirm: Add demonstration questions and clinical cases to the shared question bank? Existing sample questions will not be duplicated.

database.pdfSelectionFilters: Use search, category and tag filters
database.pdfQuestionSearch: Search questions to add to this export
database.pdfManualHint: Select across searches/pages and arrange the export order below. PDF, Excel, CSV and JSON use this exact selection and ignore content filters. Portable packages continue to use filters.
database.pdfChooseQuestions: Choose at least one question before exporting.
database.pdfModeHint: PDF only. Other export formats stay unchanged.
database.pdfAnswersHint: Separate answer sections include links from each question to its answer and back.
database.pdfQuizHint: White/light-grey compact layout. Answers, explanations, answer links and source/tag hints are omitted.
database.exportTitleHint: This title appears in the PDF header and filename only. Excel / CSV / JSON formats ignore it. Leave empty for the default title.
database.includeAboutPage: Include an About Us page in PDF
database.includeAboutPageHint: PDF only. When enabled, this page is placed before the question bank.
database.aboutPageBodyPlaceholder: Introduce the organization, course, or document...
database.title: Database information
database.exportStateDesc: Portable, versioned JSON or multi-sheet Excel package containing the selected questions and their categories, hierarchical tags, cases, authors, moderation state, statistics, provenance, translations, timestamps, and optional embedded images.
database.exportStateStartedExcel: Building the Excel question bank package...
database.exportStateStartedWithImages: Building the question bank package with images...
database.exportStateStartedWithoutImages: Building the question bank package without images...
database.filtersHint: Optional. Leave every field empty to export all questions. Filters apply to every export format (Excel / CSV / JSON / PDF).
database.filtersSharedHint: Use filters or manually choose questions for PDF, Excel, CSV and JSON. Portable packages use filters. About-page fields apply only to PDF.
database.filtersSearchHint: Search text, explanation, and source (min 2 characters)
database.editableExportDesc: Human-editable Excel, CSV, JSON, or print-ready PDF. These files are for review and editing; use a question bank package to preserve the complete related-data graph.
database.backupDesc: Server recovery snapshot containing all operational database data. Use it for disaster recovery, not for moving a selected question set between systems.
database.restoreConfirm: The current database will be replaced by the backup {name}. A safety backup will be created automatically before the restore.
database.restorePasswordPlaceholder: Enter your admin password to confirm
database.dangerDesc: Clearing the database will delete all questions ({questions}) and {sessions} self-study sessions. A backup will be created automatically before clearing. This operation cannot be undone.
database.clearAdminPasswordPlaceholder: Enter your admin password to confirm
database.qualityDesc: Scan the bank for duplicate text or choices, missing metadata, and translation-choice mismatches. The scan is read-only; creating flags adds normal moderation reports.
database.qualityLoadFailed: Failed to load the data-quality report

tags.title: Tag management
tags.emptyDesc: Tags appear when added to questions
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete tag "{name}"? The tag will be removed from all questions.
tags.mergeCount: {count} tags will be merged into one.
tags.mergeSameError: A tag cannot be merged into itself

groups.title: Group management
groups.emptyDesc: Create a group and add members to appear on the leaderboard.
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete group "{name}"? All members will be removed.
groups.emptyMembersDesc: Add members to appear on the leaderboard.

blueprints.title: Exam blueprints
blueprints.emptyDesc: Create a blueprint to distribute questions across categories by weight.
blueprints.name: Blueprint name
blueprints.weightsHint: Set a weight for each category. Weights are relative — the sum does not need to be 100. Leave all weights at 0 for a random distribution across the entire verified pool.

import.title: Import questions
import.mappingIntro: Found {count} author(s) not present on this system. Choose how to attribute each one's questions.
import.mappingActionStubHint: A placeholder account with only this name — cannot log in
import.mappingActionNullHint: Questions will be owned by you but unattributed
import.mappingUsersUnavailable: Could not fetch the user list (you may lack the user-management capability). "Assign to existing user" is disabled.
import.fileLabel: Drag and drop Excel / CSV / JSON files here
import.fileHint: Select multiple files from a folder (for example, DSM-5 chapters), or drop them here. Max: 50 MB per file. CSV columns: question, choice_1, choice_2, correct_answer; JSON: question, choices, correct_answer.
import.telegramLabel: Drag and drop result.json from Telegram here
import.telegramHint: The file must be exported from Telegram's data export
import.badType: File type not allowed: {ext}. Supported types: {allowed}
import.badTelegramType: Please choose a JSON file only

unlock.hint: The normal limit is 10 imports per hour. Enter your administrator password to bypass that limit for this login session for 10 minutes. It returns automatically when the window expires.
unlock.active: The import limit is temporarily bypassed for this login session. It returns automatically after 10 minutes.
unlock.limited: The server import limit was reached. Unlock imports with your administrator password above, then click Import to resume the queued files.

queue.reviewFailure: Import stopped. Check the question bank before submitting a failed file again: a lost response may hide a successful import. Imported and failed files will not be resent; click Import to continue with the remaining queued files.

import.stateLabel: Drag and drop a question bank package (.json or .xlsx) here
import.stateHint: Includes categories, hierarchical tags, cases, full question fields, provenance, translations, authors, and images
import.badStateType: Please choose a question bank package in JSON or XLSX format
import.stateModeMerge: Merge — add new questions; handle matching questions with the conflict strategy below
import.stateModeReplace: Replace — handle matching questions with the conflict strategy and remove public questions missing from a complete package
import.stateReplaceWarning: Public questions absent from a complete package will be permanently deleted. Matching questions follow the selected conflict strategy, and local drafts absent from the package are kept. Selective packages cannot use replace mode.
import.statePreviewHint: Counts are estimates — they are recomputed inside the atomic transaction. Images are skipped if their base64 payload cannot be decoded.
import.conflictStrategyLabel: When an imported question conflicts with a local question
import.conflictReviewIntro: Choose which version to keep for {count} conflicting questions.
